verdict.rationale: Attio offers a broad REST API (CRUD on objects/lists, filtering, webhooks, OAuth) plus an MCP server for AI agents to search/update/manage the workspace, suggesting strong API parity for core CRM operations. However, some UI-surfaced features (workflow automation builder, reporting/visualization engine, call recording/AI insights) aren't clearly exposed as documented API endpoints, and no public OpenAPI spec was found, so full UI-API parity isn't confirmed.
